payload.title: The general AI persona, which belongs to no module, carries the farm water-chemistry and reagent-dosing calculators, and every water-chemistry, aquaculture-math and sensor-config tool is declared module-less, so any AI user without a farm or sensor grant is offered farm and sensor domain tools
evidence: apps/ai-service/src/agent/personas/specialties/general.specialty.ts:9-23 (the general specialty has requiresModule null, bundles seven water-chemistry and dosing tools, and is told to answer sensor questions)
apps/ai-service/src/tools/water-chemistry/calculate-reagent-dosing.tool.ts:100 (the reagent dosing calculator declares requiresModule: null)
apps/ai-service/src/tools/sensor-config/analyze-sensor-data.tool.ts:132 (the sensor analysis tool is module-less as well)
apps/ai-service/src/tools/core/tool.interface.ts:41-46 (requiresModule null is defined as a core tool)
apps/ai-service/src/agent/agent-profile.service.ts:151-153 (the module filter rejects only tools with a non-null module, so module-less tools pass for every persona)
libs/shared-contracts/src/ai/persona-catalogue.ts:48-49 (AiSpecialtyModule can only be 'farm', so sensor or hr ownership cannot be expressed)
payload.rule_violated: Under D2 and D4, AI is module-scoped and farm-domain capability must not be reachable without a farm grant; the general persona belongs to no module.
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-23, release R8.
